Backticks code block style uses triple backtick fences

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"code_block_style\":\"Backticks\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<pre><code class=\"language-js\">console.log('hi');</code></pre>", options)
```
